bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then SUDO=''; else SUDO='sudo -n'; fi
$SUDO bash <<'ADMIN2_KEY_SETUP'
set -eu
getent passwd admin1 >/dev/null
if getent passwd admin2 >/dev/null; then echo ADMIN2_ACCOUNT=EXISTS; else useradd -m -s /bin/bash admin2; echo ADMIN2_ACCOUNT=CREATED; fi
h=$(getent passwd admin2 | cut -d: -f6)
[ "$h" = /home/admin2 ] || { echo ADMIN2_HOME_UNEXPECTED; exit 30; }
[ ! -L "$h" ] && [ ! -L "$h/.ssh" ] && [ ! -L "$h/.ssh/authorized_keys" ] || { echo ADMIN2_SYMLINK_REFUSED; exit 31; }
for g in $(id -nG admin1); do
  if [ "$g" != admin1 ] && getent group "$g" >/dev/null; then usermod -aG "$g" admin2; fi
done
grp=$(id -gn admin2)
install -d -m 700 -o admin2 -g "$grp" "$h/.ssh"
auth="$h/.ssh/authorized_keys"
[ -e "$auth" ] || install -m 600 -o admin2 -g "$grp" /dev/null "$auth"
pub='ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIMa5pDFPDoQoRARKZIsitJHNUtj3lT/b1vY3Xi8l/8br contabo-admin2-recovery-20261021'
if grep -Fqx "$pub" "$auth"; then echo ADMIN2_KEY=ALREADY_PRESENT; else printf '\n%s\n' "$pub" >> "$auth"; echo ADMIN2_KEY=ADDED; fi
chown admin2:"$grp" "$h/.ssh" "$auth"
chmod 700 "$h/.ssh"
chmod 600 "$auth"
printf 'ADMIN2_GROUPS='; id -nG admin2
echo ADMIN2_KEY_INSTALL=PASS
ADMIN2_KEY_SETUP
